implementation_scope: Finite labels, operation-word paths, occurrence records, grouping families and the fixed-source Bool Tick tag fragment. This is not all WG sources or an implemented universal carrier.

primitive_bindings.implementation: TickFragment ordered tags, routes, rebuild and swap; no endpoint quotient of arbitrary paths
promote with explicit grouping key and batch namespace; all member occurrences retained
Native basis/permutation encoding and source/schedule binding to accepted spectral witness
Delta-basis coordinates and mathematical intensities; full records retained separately

identity_policy.path_identity: Within the versioned namespace, source plus full operation word determines a structural path ID. Equal endpoints do not identify paths.
identity_policy.occurrence_identity: Caller-supplied unique occurrence IDs distinguish repeated equal records and preserve multiplicity.
identity_policy.family_identity: Explicit batch namespace plus grouping key and key value identifies a promoted family. Caller must not reuse a batch identity for changed membership without a version/history policy.
identity_policy.promotion_endpoints: This constructor returns family records only; it does not infer a next-level relation or endpoint assignment.
identity_policy.independent_comparison: Not implemented or inferred by grouping. Any product constructor requires its own declared domain and parent provenance.

scope_maps.formula: Bool pair maps identically to Label; native left/right flip maps to Operation.LEFT/RIGHT
scope_maps.required_law: apply agrees with the native factor map on every source label

scope_maps.formula: label maps to delta basis; each native operation maps to its source-linearized permutation; path word maps to its ordered operator composition
scope_maps.required_law: source action and composition square commute

scope_maps.formula: At a fixed Bool source, the full native Tick maps to its ordered schedule tags, then TickFragment; rebuilding uses the existing native tags equivalence
scope_maps.required_law: Preserve both tags and reconstruct only within the proven Bool specialization, not arbitrary path histories

scope_maps.formula: Native target is both-flipped source; each return executes the forward schedule's two operations in reverse order with positive phase
scope_maps.required_law: Source attachment, distinct seam labels and swap agree with the accepted spectral return

scope_maps.formula: Compose delta/permutation encoding with accepted complex-real transport
scope_maps.required_law: Use the accepted finite overlap, theta=pi*t and z*Hz=2E; do not introduce a second generator

remaining: Admission of this new executable adapter at its stated verification level
An all-source common-carrier construction if required

boundary: Implemented finite structural fragment and candidate adapter. Existing formal native-source results are imported by scope, not replayed as Python native terms or generalized to all sources.
